values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/detour ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Detour State Forest Campground: 21 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in access to Lake Huron about 200 feet from the campground parking area; no boat ramp.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/detour ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'Carry-in access to Lake Huron is approximately 200 feet from the parking area') + amenity table (boat access: C), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/detour ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 21 sites for tents and small trailers, including three spacious sites that take 40-foot vehicles/trailers. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/detour ('Offering 21 sites for tents and small trailers, including three spacious sites capable of accommodating 40-foot vehicles/trailers'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (21 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the Lake Huron shore, 5 miles west of DeTour Village via M-134; managed by Brimley State Park. Sandy Lake Huron beaches. Access road is narrow and winding through pine/hemlock, fine for a 23-ft rig but not big-rig friendly (reviewers warn ~30 ft practical max). --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 21 sites, three of them for 40-ft rigs (max_rig_ft 40 new), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed). Season (closed Nov 1 - May 1) already manual and matches the table. Phone differs (flag). Note trimmed of field restatements.
